question_summary: Request approval to substitute ABS DWV piping for specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping, contingent on equivalent performance and code listings.
proposed_solution: Use ABS DWV piping in lieu of specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping.
deadline_text: by the end of the day
routing_rationale: The substitution directly affects plumbing system materials and code compliance, which should be evaluated by the plumbing engineer of record.
